title: Te Rere ki te Moana Pōuriuri
intro: Whakaarohia te tū i runga i te papa o tētahi waka kua kī tonu i te taumaha, i te ngaru e ngaru ana, ā, e maka rota ana te kapa hei whakamama i te kawenga. He tangata takitahi e hikoi whakamua ana, e whakaae ana ki tētahi aituā e āhua nei ko te mutunga, engari ko ngā hohonutanga ka noho hei wāhi inoi me te hokinga mai. Kei muri e tū ana tētahi hapori e whakatūpato ana mō te whiu e haere mai ana, kei mua e tū ana tētahi aroha noa kāore i te tumanakohia.
clues: I tonoa ahau hei karere ki te neke atu i te kotahi rau mano tāngata.
I mahue i ahau tōku iwi me te riri i mua i taku whiwhinga i te whakaaetanga kia haere.
I eke ahau ki runga i tētahi kaipuke kī tonu i te uta, ā, i maka rota ngā kaimahi ki te whakatau ko wai ka maka ki te moana.
I maka ahau ki te moana, ā, i horomia e te ika nui, i ahau e whakapae ana.
I whakakororia ahau i a Allah i roto i te pōuri, me te kī kāore he atua engari ko Ia, ā, i roto ahau i te hunga hara.
I maka ahau ki te takutai moana, e mate ana, ā, i meinga e Atua kia tupu ake he hue ki runga i ahau, kātahi ka whakapono taku iwi, ā, i whakamanahia mai ki a rātou te oranga mō tētahi wā.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Poropiti a Mohi
Poropiti a Hūta
Poropiti a Noa
Poropiti Ruta
Poropiti Yunus

trial.label: He aha te whakamātautau i pā ki ahau?
options: Ka maka ki roto i te ahi kua whakamatao, kua haumaru hoki
I horomia e te ika nui i muri i tana rerenga
Makaia ki roto i te poka hohonu e ngā tuakana hae
I pāngia e te mate roa me te ngaronga o te hauora
I whakahaua kia patua he tamaiti aroha
trial.answer: I horomia e te ika nui i muri i tana rerenga

location.label: He aha taku Huānga Matua?
options: Te Āka rakau i runga i ngā wai waipuke
Te ana piringa mai i te whakatoi
Te awaawa tapu o Tūwa
Te ika nui me tōna puku
Te ahi matao i whakaritea e ngā kaikarakia whakapakoko
location.answer: Te ika nui me tōna puku

outcome.label: He aha te hua i puta mai i ahau?
options: I whakaorangia e te whakakororia, ā, i whakapono taku iwi, ā, i whakaorangia mō tētahi wā
I hurihia taku iwi hei makimaki mō te takahi i te Hāpati
I horomia tōku iwi e te whenua i te whakapehapeha
I hopukia tōku iwi e te pahūtanga nui i te rangi
I toremi tōku iwi i te waipuke nui
outcome.answer: I whakaorangia e te whakakororia, ā, i whakapono taku iwi, ā, i whakaorangia mō tētahi wā

arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
verse: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more. (37:147)
